title: Homilies on Leviticus, Homilia II
blurb: Origen’s Homilia II on Leviticus (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–5.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia II on Leviticus — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Barkley FOTC 83 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homilia II §§1–5 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VI (GCS 29, 1920), Rufinus’s Latin of Homilia II. Barkley FOTC 83 was not used as wording. This page is Homilia II §§1–5 (closeout).
